mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lung and body routes was most worthwhile: the continuous arrows made it clear how blood travels through both sides of the heart.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the second valve on each side felt repetitive, and the descriptions saying the already-filled chamber gap remained pale were confusing.

surprise.text: The heart muscle needs its own blood vessels because blood in the chambers cannot supply all of it.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed purposeless, though several later combinations were the only offered options rather than meaningful choices.

continue.text: I would continue to see how another body system connects to circulation, although I hope for more meaningful choices and clearer fitting descriptions.
